commands.name: submit
commands.description: Propose a local or external asset to the catalog through a pull request

options.name: --help
options.description:
Prints help information
folder, or URL

options.name: --id
options.description:
Catalog id. Default: derived from the file,
folder, or URL

options.name: --name
options.description: Display name. Default: the id in title case

options.name: --description
options.description:
One line telling a reader when to use this
asset
new asset, the next patch when updating

options.name: --version
options.description:
Catalog asset version. Default: 1.0.0 for a
new asset, the next patch when updating

options.name: --ref
options.description:
Specific external commit or immutable tag.
Omit to pin the latest current commit

options.name: --group
options.description:
Catalog groups this asset belongs to
(repeatable or comma-separated)

options.name: --provider
options.description:
Limit to specific providers. Omit for all
providers (the default)

options.name: --license
options.description:
SPDX license identifier for an external
asset, when known

options.name: --command
options.description:
Hook entry file, or the executable for a
stdio MCP server

options.name: --trigger
options.description: Hook event. Default: preToolUse

options.name: --tool
options.description:
Optional hook tool matcher, for example
Bash

options.name: --timeout
options.description:
Hook timeout in seconds. Default: 30
inferred

options.name: --transport
options.description:
MCP transport: stdio, http, or sse. Usually
inferred

options.name: --url
options.description:
HTTP/SSE MCP endpoint. Use
environment-backed headers for
authentication

options.name: --arg
options.description:
MCP process argument. Repeat for multiple
arguments

options.name: --env
options.description:
MCP environment variable name.
Never pass a secret value

options.name: --header-env
options.description:
MCP HTTP header backed by an environment
variable, for example
Authorization=API_TOKEN

options.name: --yes
options.description:
Publish the previewed files without an
interactive confirmation

options.name: --draft
options.description: Open the pull request as a draft

options.name: --prepare-only
options.description:
Create and commit the proposal branch
locally, but do not push or open a PR

options.name: --update
options.description:
Propose a new revision of an asset that is
already in the catalog

arguments.name: KIND
arguments.description:
Asset kind, for example skill, hook, mcp, prompt,
agent, or tool

arguments.name: PATH_OR_URL_OR_ID
arguments.description:
Local file/folder, external git URL, or the id of an
MCP server
